players.bio: Andrés Vombergar (born 20 November 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for San Lorenzo. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Slovenia national team. Early life Vombergar was born in Argentina to Slovenian parents and grew up bilingual. Club career Vombergar began his senior career with Ituzaingó in 2014.
Axel Wilfredo Werner (born 28 February 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer for Spanish club Elche CF as a goalkeeper.

Emanuel Fernando Maciel (born 28 March 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Aldosivi. Career San Lorenzo gave Maciel his beginnings in football, initially in their youth academy. He made a breakthrough into the first-team during 2018–19, as he was on the substitute's bench for two matches in league and cup.
Esteban Leonardo Rolón (born 25 March 1995) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Spanish club Málaga CF.

Facundo Sebastián De La Vega (born 15 April 2003) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a striker for Aldosivi. Career Raised in the Aldosivi youth sector, he made his debut in the first team on 7 June 2022 in the Argentine first division match lost 2-1 against Argentinos Juniors.
Federico Óscar Andrada (born 3 March 1994) is an Argentine footballer who plays for Aldosivi as a forward.

Federico Gino Acevedo Fagúndez (born 26 February 1993) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Argentine Primera División club Aldosivi. Career After graduating from Defensor Sporting's youth system, Gino made his professional debut on 25 August 2013, in a 1–1 home draw against Peñarol. PAS Giannina In December 2022, he signed for PAS Giannina in Super League Greece.

Fernando Aurelio Román Villalba (born 20 November 1998) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Argentine club Aldosivi. Career Román played for the Escuela de Fútbol Pastoreo in his early years, prior to heading to Libertad.
Franco Ezequiel Leys (born 18 October 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for America de Cali.
Guillermo Enrique (born 24th February 2000) is an Argentine footballer who plays as an Right-Back for Gimnasia LP.

Guillermo Martín Farré (born 16 August 1981) is an Argentine football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the current manager of Aldosivi. Career Farré played club football for Belgrano. He scored a famous goal in the second leg of the club's 2010–11 Primera B Nacional promotion playoff victory over River Plate.
Joaquín Ariel Novillo (born 19 February 1998) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Chilean Primera División club Deportes Iquique.
Joel Gustavo Acosta (born 16 January 1991 in Villa Gobernador Gálvez) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Aldosivi.
Jorge Carlos Carranza (born 7 May 1981) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Aldosivi.

Leonardo Germán Sigali (Spanish pronunciation: ; born 28 May 1987) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Racing Club. Club career Sigali came through the youth system at Nueva Chicago, club from the Western part of the Argentine capital, to make his professional debut in 2006.

Lucas Mauricio Acosta (born 12 March 1995) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Sarmiento, on loan from Lanús. Career Acosta started his career in 2013 with Primera División side Belgrano.
Lucas Nahuel Castro (born 9 April 1989) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Gimnasia La Plata, as a winger.
Lucas Nahuel Rodríguez (born 27 September 1993) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a left-back for Instituto.
Matías Emanuel Godoy (born 10 January 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Central Córdoba SdE, on loan from Estudiantes de La Plata.
Mauro Andrés Da Luz Regalado (born September 5, 1994) is a Uruguayan footballer who plays for Club 9 de Octubre on loan from Uruguayan side River Plate.

Nicolás Fernando Cordero (born 11 April 1999) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Instituto on loan from Huracán. Club career Cordero's career began with Huracán. He first appeared in the club's first-team squad in July 2016, when manager Eduardo Domínguez selected as a substitute for a Copa Argentina encounter with Central Córdoba.

Osvaldo Fabián Nicolás "Nico" Gaitán born 23 February 1988) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger. Currently a free agent, he most recently played for Portuguese club Paços de Ferreira.
Nicolás Mauricio Zalazar (born 29 January 1997) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Instituto, on loan from Colombian club Junior.
